decisions.subject: Composition runtime for source-led football recap

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Best fit for real match footage as anchor plus React-native data overlays and one-pass composition.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Strong for HTML/GSAP kinetic typography, but less natural here because source footage is primary.
options_considered.rejected_because: The match footage, not kinetic HTML graphics, is the primary medium.

decisions.reason: User approved Remotion after both supported runtimes were presented.

decisions.subject: Creative direction

options_considered.label: Match Pulse
options_considered.reason: Keeps goals primary while using motion graphics as rhythmic support.

options_considered.label: Tactical Data Broadcast
options_considered.reason: Strong analytical framing but risks making the data heavier than the match footage.

options_considered.label: Night Match Cinema
options_considered.reason: Cinematic atmosphere but would reduce the density of useful match statistics.

decisions.reason: User approved Match Pulse as the best balance of highlights, data motion and premium broadcast feel.
